hero.tagline: Delight your fragrance, aroma, and flavor
hero.description: We are specialty coffee growers and producers in Pueblo Bello, Colombia. Guided by the Arhuaco meaning of Kinki —real, true, and original— we bring the soul of the Sierra straight to your cup with Carlos's craft and care.

kinki.title: The Meaning of
kinki.subtitle: In the ancestral language of the Arhuaco people of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, the word Kinki means:
kinki.p1: For Carlos and his family, Kafé Kinki is far more than a name: it is a commitment to origin, identity, and deep reverence for the sacred mountains of the Sierra Nevada. Carlos's Indigenous roots guide every step on the farm, knowing coffee is a living bridge between the mountain mists, the fertile earth, and human hands.
kinki.p2: Naming our coffee Kinki honors the genuine: coffee free from artificial shortcuts or industrial processing, shade-grown beneath native forest canopies and hand-harvested with patience and honesty.

story.title: From our land
story.p1: Behind every bag of Kafé Kinki is Carlos, a coffee grower and producer from Pueblo Bello, Cesar. His bond with coffee was forged not in a corporate boardroom, but along the mountain trails of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.
story.p2: Unlike mass industrial coffee, Kafé Kinki is the result of independent, small-batch craftsmanship. Every coffee tree is planted, naturally nourished, and cared for by hand, safeguarding the living biodiversity of the mountain ecosystem.
story.quote: Growing specialty coffee is more than an occupation—it is our way of honoring the land and sharing the genuine aroma of the Sierra with the world.

origin.title: From the Sierra Nevada to your cup,
origin.subtitle: Kafé Kinki's authenticity stems from the unique geography of Pueblo Bello and respect for every stage of the coffee's journey.
origin.locationBannerDesc: A realm of morning mists, fertile mountain soils, and ancestral reverence where Carlos grows with devotion.

steps.title: Pueblo Bello
steps.desc: The starting point in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada. A fertile region blessed with lush vegetation and coffee-growing heritage.

steps.title: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
steps.desc: The sacred mountain creates cool air currents, misty mornings, and nutrient-rich volcanic soils for slow, sweet cherry maturation.

steps.title: Shade-Grown Farming
steps.desc: Coffee trees thrive protected under native canopy shade, fostering natural biodiversity and safeguarding mountain soil.

steps.title: Selective Hand Harvesting
steps.desc: Every cherry is hand-picked exclusively at peak red ripeness, ensuring only wholesome, naturally sweet fruits are gathered.

steps.title: Sun Drying on Raised Beds
steps.desc: A meticulous process where beans breathe and gently dry under the Andean sun and mountain breeze, locking in aromatic sugars.

steps.title: Your Cup of Coffee
steps.desc: A genuine Kinki (real and true) experience, straight from the Colombian countryside to your cup with Carlos's signature seal.

coffee.title: Our
coffee.subtitle: Grown, hand-selected, and roasted in artisanal small batches. Available in whole bean for freshly ground aroma, and precision ground ready to brew.

wholeBean.subtitle: Artisanal Coffee from the Sierra Nevada

wholeBean.description: 100% Colombian specialty coffee, shade-grown and hand-harvested by Carlos. Whole bean format to grind freshly before each brew and delight in the distinct aroma and flavor of the Sierra Nevada.

ground.name: Kafé Kinki — Ground Coffee
ground.subtitle: Artisanal Coffee from the Sierra Nevada
ground.tagline: Ready to brew in pour over, French press, drip filter, or moka pot.
ground.description: The exact same specialty coffee from Pueblo Bello, ground with artisanal precision to deliver a balanced, aromatic, full-bodied cup from the very first pour.

process.title: Care in
process.subtitle: Producing specialty coffee is not an industrial assembly line; it is a daily commitment of patience, mindfulness, and respect for the land in Pueblo Bello.

stages.title: The Farm & The Soil
stages.subtitle: Daily care of each living plant
stages.description: In Pueblo Bello, every coffee tree is attended with continuous care. Carlos walks his plots inspecting leaf vitality, blossoming flowers, and cherry growth under the mountain climate.

stages.title: Selective Hand Harvesting
stages.subtitle: Only cherries at peak sweetness
stages.description: Harvesting is patient manual labor. No mechanical harvesters are used: trained eyes and gentle hands select exclusively the deep-crimson ripe cherries.

stages.title: Natural Washing & Sun Drying
stages.subtitle: Beans resting under the Andean sky
stages.description: The coffee is depulped and spread over ventilated African raised beds. Andean sunshine and mountain breezes gently dry the beans to ideal moisture levels.

stages.title: Artisanal Medium Roast
stages.subtitle: Highlighting fragrance, aroma, and body
stages.description: A balanced medium roast allows the coffee to express its true origin profile: neither underdeveloped nor burnt. It unlocks the vibrant aroma and delicate fragrance defining Kafé Kinki.
